_comment: Where to look for jobs. Edit feeds/searches freely.
_minScoreComment: Cold applications must clear a HIGH bar (much stricter than inbound replies) so you only apply to strong automation matches, not spray-and-pray. Raise to be pickier, lower for more results.
_excludeTitleComment: Job titles containing any of these whole words are skipped before scoring (no application package), across all sources. Used to drop entry-level roles. Matched in the title only, so senior roles that merely mention these words in the description are kept.

djinni._comment: Public Djinni jobs board, read with a plain fetch (no login, no browser). Each search is a full jobs-search URL — copy them from your browser's filters. Use primary_keyword=QA+Automation or primary_keyword=QA (Manual) for categories, or all_keywords=TERM for free-text. fullDescription (default true) follows each job link for the complete text so scoring is accurate; set false to score on the listing snippet only.

linkedin._comment: Scraping LinkedIn job search violates ToS and is more detectable. Kept modest: few results, polite delays. Set enabled=false to turn off.
